batch.description: Dhaka University A Unit question bank, academic session 2024-2025; digitized from the supplied scanned PDF. Contains six 15-question subject sections; the printed exam pattern asks candidates to answer any four sections.

sourceDocuments.title: DU A Unit question bank and supplied answer key, 2024-2025
sourceDocuments.notes: Original scanned PDF retained unchanged at /home/kali/gpt-workspace/bd-admission-app-data. Question/option text and answer letters were transcribed from this supplied scan; no external re-verification was performed. A dash in the printed key is preserved as unknown rather than guessed. Some source items are diagram-based; their options are represented in text where possible. One formula-based Higher Mathematics item (Q15) is content-unverified because the scanned expression is not legible enough to guarantee transcription; its publisher-key letter is retained but it is excluded from scored practice until checked against a clearer source.

papers.title: DU A Unit Question Bank Practice — 2024-2025

examRules.sourceNote: This rule is transcribed from the supplied publisher-produced scanned question bank and is illustrative, not an official verified exam rule. The publisher scan uses 60 MCQs in 45 minutes, +1/−0.25, and an any-four-of-six 15-question subject-section pattern. The official University of Dhaka 2025–2026 admission notice describes a different complete exam: 60 marks of MCQ plus 40 marks of written questions, with 45 minutes for each part (published 13 October 2025; https://www.du.ac.bd/du_post_details/news/25400). Therefore this app mode simulates the publisher question-bank MCQ pattern only, not the complete official DU admission exam. Confirm the exact session and paper pattern from its official notice before any future change to verified status.
